faq.q: What is the origin of Asghar?
faq.a: Asghar is associated with Arabic. Aṣghar ('younger, smaller, junior'), elative of صغير. Borne by the companion Aṣghar ibn Qays.
Yes — the underlying form أصغر is Arabic.
Asghar can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Asghar should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. أصغر occurs in the Qur'an (10:61, 34:3) as a normal Arabic elative
